notes:
Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter and Zaiqa Kitchen apps, version 2.17.0.

Two kitchens, two printers
- New card in Manage Printer: "Two kitchens: BBQ printer". Switch it on, choose the BBQ printer and tick the categories that belong to BBQ.
- An order with fries, a cold drink and tikka boti now prints two slips with the same KOT number: BBQ items on the BBQ printer, everything else on the counter printer. Bills and customer copies always print on the counter printer.
- Works for dine-in, takeaway and delivery, and for extra, cancelled and reprinted KOTs. Deals are split by their parts.
- If the BBQ printer is off or out of range, its slip prints at the counter with a warning so nothing is lost.
- Switch it off at any time and everything prints on the counter printer again.
